title: search_jobs Input
description: Input schema for the search_jobs tool.

query.description: Natural language search query, e.g. 'senior backend engineer remote'

remote_policy.description: Filter to roles matching any of these remote policies (e.g. ['hybrid', 'remote']). Complements remote_ok, which stays meaningful as 'remote or flexible'; use this when the candidate wants a specific policy such as hybrid.

employment_type.description: Standard values: full_time, part_time, contract, internship, temporary. Providers MAY accept additional values.

experience_level.description: Standard values: entry, mid, senior, lead, director, executive. Providers MAY accept additional values.
